title: Obscura's Scar / Anomalous Mark Record
summary: Restricted record concerning the anomalous physical mark known as Obscura's Scar.
body:
ACCESS RESTRICTED

This record has been restricted pending internal review.

No reliable determination of the origin, mechanism or purpose of Obscura's Scar has been established.

The mark is physical and anomalous. Comparable individuals bearing the same mark have reportedly demonstrated unexplained abilities.

Members of Last Call are believed to have acquired the mark shortly before their separation and incarceration in late August, 323 SE.

The relationship between the mark and the abilities reported in comparable subjects remains unknown.

Further material withheld.

ARCHIVE NOTE:
Access key verification successful. Record remains restricted by policy.
